folds.heading: ### Book-world checkpoint and five-row coverage uptake B267
folds.body:
Full [book-world checkpoint](gm/book-world-completion-2026-10-06/CHECKPOINT.md) revision7 and all five rows of [coverage](gm/book-world-completion-2026-10-06/COVERAGE.json) revision2 were reviewed. They record October7 source/native/UI/compatible-state/current-build work as implemented-unverified. Native/model constructor, gameplay, unit, browser, save/reload/import, failure, regression, keyboard and director checks are explicitly unrun there. Ink diagnostics, syntax, locators, served bundle/source maps and static link/anchor recovery are different proof from executing a native constructor or playing a journey. In particular the model import encountered a DOM requirement; the receipt did not repair that by asserting native instantiation.

All five rows remain finite, distinct outcomes. Row2's “runtime absent” is its earlier baseline, not its resulting implementation status or a current-source absence claim. Its selected era still needed pinning in the cited source cell. A completed dossier and24profiles do not source-qualify every proposed Cyoria price, term, engineer route or later novel mechanism. The selected Cyoria life is an independent retained-human non-mage, not Zorian's protagonist path, and the Paradise/Goa branch is likewise finite original side-branch work. Neither establishes whole-book/whole-world or19world completion.

The recorded35Paradise+59MOL actions do total94, but1153commands/52controllers/23conditions/nine worlds/13encounters/56sources are aggregate registry counts, not whole-world gameplay denominators. The335local maps and37vendors qualify that build's correspondence, not present source parity. Build ebf951d62861, old preview ports/session IDs/PIDs, source reservations and released workers are historical references; none was probed as live now. No duplicate server, worker, successor or automatic acceptance run was started.

The checkpoint also preserves an important authoring-history recovery: an earlier guide overwrite with evidence JSON was reportedly restored from exact literal edits before book interfaces were appended. Its recovery/BEFORE_CANONICAL pointers should stay intact. Reading this receipt neither independently repeats that byte recovery nor credits the full restored guide or linked delivery/evidence bodies as read. The current review preserves original record identity, rather than replacing authoring content with this new evidence summary.

Old one-prestige and mandatory director-phase language is qualified by [the retired milestone](USER_VISION.md#first-milestone-and-scope-check-2026-10-24), AD42 optional human review and current AD36/AD43 verification stages. Do not promote deferred checks to passes, or treat an old implementation-first exception as a new general waiver. Current selected task and source/consumer evidence determine further work; this uptake adds no runtime, integration, test or campaign dispatch.
